summary: Reviewed and fixed the world-core child journey. Fixes: onboarding could create two profiles on a fast double tap on "¡Vamos!", and a failed progress unlock left an orphan child; the form now sits on a translucent card; StoryPlayer keyboard handling (Enter on Salir/Saltar advanced instead of activating, duplicate stage and window handlers, held keys raced through the story) is corrected; header and nav buttons on home, map, picker, onboarding and story are now 56px (the shared sm button is 44px). A regression test for the double-tap was added. Typecheck is clean for src/world and all 57 world tests pass (plus the new onboarding test). Screenshots of home, map and onboarding on iPad landscape look right.
publicApi: Unchanged from the original report: default exports ChildPickerScreen, OnboardingScreen, ChildHomeScreen, WorldMapScreen, NodeScreen, StoryPlayer, CompanionBuddy; named GameHostProvider, useBuddyBus, ReactionEvent from src/world/host/GameHost.tsx.
tests: npx vitest run src/world: 15 files, 57 tests passed after the main edits; onboarding suite re-run after adding the double-tap test: 3 of 3 passed. npm run typecheck filtered to src/world: zero errors. Screenshots (shots/): world-home-ipad.png, world-map-ipad.png, onboarding-ipad.png, captured via tools/shot.mjs with CHROMIUM_PATH set. Not re-run after the last edits: the full src/world suite, the Android and portrait captures.
openIssues: Home: the 'Familia' ghost button still sits on the light string decoration at the top edge; low contrast on the iPad capture.
Onboarding: the disabled Siguiente button is grey-on-light and reads weakly; consider a clearer disabled style.
Map: the guardian predicament and 'Aquí' tag are visible in the capture, but portrait and Android captures were not taken.
Galleries for picker, home, map and onboarding were not added (only StoryPlayer has one).
Tests still mock '@/activities' in GameHost.test.tsx and NodeScreen.test.tsx; remove once the lessons module lands.
CompanionBuddy remounts the figures per reaction (keyed wrapper); cheaper to key only the animation class.
StoryPlayer predicament rescue value is scene_index / (scenes - 1); content may want an explicit rescue marker per scene.

Other agents or the user edited OnboardingScreen.tsx, OnboardingScreen.module.css, OnboardingScreen.test.tsx, WorldMapScreen.tsx, ChildPickerScreen.tsx and StoryPlayer.tsx on disk during this review. My patches were applied to their current content with uniqueness checks; the external changes were not reverted and were not reviewed in full.
contractRequests: tools/shot.mjs: hardcoded Linux Chromium executablePath fails on macOS (still open; CHROMIUM_PATH workaround needed).
src/art/index.ts does not re-export COLORWAYS / Colorway / ACCESSORY_IDS (no change needed; onboarding uses COMPANION_COLORWAYS from @/content).
